critique.evidence: The screen has a clear demo-worthy visual thesis: a recorded intent-to-cart-to-payment chain culminates in a cyan/red divergence graphic, while four green VERIFIED checks are deliberately contrasted with a red semantic-mismatch reveal. The oversized editorial headline and restrained forensic palette make this feel like a narrative security exhibit rather than a generic metrics dashboard, and the core idea survives desktop, tablet, and mobile.
critique.fix: Prevent the desktop/tablet navigation rail from bisecting or obscuring hero copy, and enlarge the divergence graphic on mobile so its pivotal meaning reads as strongly as the red mismatch panel.
